scripts.db:init: docker exec -i green-releaf-postgres psql -U postgres -d green_releaf_dev < docker/postgres/init/01-init-database.sql
scripts.db:rbac: docker exec -i green-releaf-postgres psql -U postgres -d green_releaf_dev < Queries/create-rbac-schema.sql
scripts.db:metrc: docker exec -i green-releaf-postgres psql -U postgres -d green_releaf_dev < docker/postgres/init/02-create-metrc-tables.sql
scripts.db:crm: docker exec -i green-releaf-postgres psql -U postgres -d green_releaf_dev < docker/postgres/init/05-create-crm-tables.sql
scripts.db:backup: docker exec green-releaf-postgres pg_dump -U postgres green_releaf_dev > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql
scripts.db:restore: docker exec -i green-releaf-postgres psql -U postgres -d green_releaf_dev < backup.sql
scripts.sync:all:prod: npm run sync:active:prod && npm run sync:outgoing:prod && npm run sync:strains:prod && npm run sync:items:prod && npm run sync:transferred:prod && npm run sync:intransit:prod
scripts.sync:all: npm run sync:active && npm run sync:transferred && npm run sync:intransit && npm run sync:outgoing && npm run sync:items && npm run sync:strains
scripts.schema:setup: docker exec -i green-releaf-postgres psql -U postgres -d green_releaf_dev < docker/postgres/init/06-update-schema-to-production.sql
scripts.setup:full: npm run docker:up && sleep 10 && npm run db:init && npm run db:rbac && npm run db:metrc && npm run db:crm && npm run schema:setup && npm run superuser
scripts.setup:quick: npm run docker:up && sleep 5 && npm run schema:setup
